Quảng Ngãi nằm ở miền Trung Việt Nam, cá.en: The square is located in Central Vietnam, almost equal to the two ends of the country. As with other provinces in this area, Guangyi features mountains on one side of the sea. The majority are Bible people.
Quảng Ngãi nằm ở miền Trung Việt Nam, cá.zh: 广场位于中越地区,几乎等于两端. 与这一地区的其他省份一样,广义在海的一侧有山地. 多数是圣经人物.

Quảng Ngãi nổi tiếng với những di tích v.en: The Sayashi cultural monuments, Zhou San, the Grand Temple, the Mai Shan Temple, the Basteau War, are widely known for the fresh water, the golden sands and pines. The American beach is the most beautiful beach in Central. It has smooth white sand, light waves, and amber forests. Come to this place, visitors have the opportunity to visit the ancient battlefields with such familiar names as Twim, Ting, Ba Jah, the Great Wall, the American Shan.
Quảng Ngãi nổi tiếng với những di tích v.zh: 萨亚什文化古迹 周三,大寺,迈山寺,巴斯托战争,以淡水,金沙和松树而广为人知. 美国海滩是中部最美丽的海滩. 它拥有光滑的白沙,光波,以及琥珀森林. 来到此地,参观者有机会访问古战场,这些战场上都有熟悉的名字,如 T,丁,巴甲,长城,美山等.

Theo quy định, biển số xe tại mỗi địa ph.en: By regulations, the license plate plate at each locality in Guangxi Province will apply the 5-digit plate plus the individual character to distinguish.
Theo quy định, biển số xe tại mỗi địa ph.zh: 根据规定,广西省各地方的牌照牌照将采用5位牌照加个人特征区分.

Toàn tỉnh có dân số 1.219.200 người vào.en: The entire province had a population of 1,219,200 people in 2009. Around 40% of the city of Guangxi and the two northern and southern districts of the province (Shan Jing and Zichuan), which has a population density from over 500 to 3600/km2).
Toàn tỉnh có dân số 1.219.200 người vào.zh: 2009年全省人口为1219,200人. 广西全市及全省南北两个县(山静县和 Zi川县)面积约40%,人口密度在500-360万平方公里以上.

Tỉnh Quảng Ngãi cách Hà Nội 833 km theo.en: Guang Province is 833 km from Hanoi according to Highway 1. The province is covered on one side by the Mountain and on one side is the East Sea. As a result, the terrain consists of mountains, plains, coasts, and islands. The main rivers are the Tea River, the Buong, the River of Wei.
Tỉnh Quảng Ngãi cách Hà Nội 833 km theo.zh: 根据1号高速公路,广省距河内833公里. 该省一面为山地,一面为东海. 因此,地形由山地,平原,海岸,岛屿组成. 主要河流有茶河,布翁河,魏河.

Tỉnh Quảng Ngãi có 13 đơn vị hành chính.en: The province of Guangxi has 13 administrative units belonging to it, including 1 City (Chai), 1 Town (German) and the districts of Guangqi Province are 11 counties (3 Silk, Li Shan, Li Shan, Ming Long, Muchang, Shanxi, Shanxi, Shan Shan, Shan Shan, Qing, Chiang, Ziang).
Tỉnh Quảng Ngãi có 13 đơn vị hành chính.zh: 广西省下辖13个行政单位,包括1个市(市),1个镇(德),广济省下辖11个县(丝绸,李山,李山,明朗,慕昌,山西,山西,山西,山东,山西,青,蒋, Zi).

Và chắc hẳn nhiều bạn đang thắc mắc biển.en: And many of you are probably wondering which of the 76 is the province of Vietnam, right? The main answer is plate 76 in Guangxi Province.
Và chắc hẳn nhiều bạn đang thắc mắc biển.zh: 你们中许多人可能想知道76系中哪个系越南省,对吧? 主答广西省七十六号牌.
